title: Park to Clarke Angle Transform
source_docs: Motor Control Blockset HDL Support/Controls/Math Transforms/Inverse_Park_Transform.md
text: Implement dq0 to αβ0 transform, 6 inputs, 3 outputs, {Theta units} sets Unit of electrical position input; {Alpha-axis alignment} sets the dq0 reference frame, {Use block for embedded implementation (requires Motor Control Blockset™)} sets the option to use block for embedded, {Number of inputs} sets the number of block, {Theta input} sets the type of position input Sine and Cosine electrical and {Number of data points for lookup table} sets the size of lookup table array. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: dq0
ports.summary: d - q axis and zero components vector

ports.name: sinθ e
ports.summary: Sine value of rotational angle scalar

ports.name: cosθ e
ports.summary: Cosine value of rotational angle scalar

ports.name: αβ0
ports.summary: α - β axis and zero components vector

params.name: Alpha-axis alignment
params.values: dq0 reference frame alignment Q-axis (default) | D-axis

params.name: Use block for embedded implementation (requires Motor Control Blockset™)
params.values: Option to use block for embedded implementation off (default) | on

params.name: Number of inputs
params.values: Number of block inputs Two inputs (default) | Three inputs

params.name: Theta input
params.values: Type of position input Sine and Cosine electrical position (default) | Electrical position

params.name: Theta units
params.values: Unit of electrical position input Per-unit (default) | Radians | Degrees

params.name: Number of data points for lookup table
params.values: Size of lookup table array 1024 (default) | scalar
